summary:
Heap overflow in fs_read_glyphs() in the font-server client
(src/fc/fserve.c). Debian builds libXfont2 with --disable-fc
(debian/rules), so the font-server client is not compiled: the shipped
libXfont2.so.2.0.0 (1:2.0.6-1+deb13u1) contains no fs_read_glyphs or
other fserve code. Debian rates it unimportant ("Disabled support to
connect to font server since 1:1.4.7-1").
